verdict.rationale: Unstructured publishes its own API reference section covering workflow, job, and source-connector endpoints, plus quickstarts with sample Python and cURL scripts users can run. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive in-browser playground or try-it console, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so the interactive part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
